title: Linux support is coming to Snapdragon X2 Series
summary: Qualcomm announced official Linux support for their Snapdragon X2 Series chips designed for AI PCs, marking a significant expansion beyond Windows-only support. This enables developers and enterprises to run Linux workloads on ARM-based Snapdragon hardware.
problem_solved: Enables Linux operating system support on Snapdragon X2 Series AI PCs, opening the platform to developers and enterprise users who prefer or require Linux environments.
why_valuable: Linux support expands the Snapdragon X2 platform's appeal to the massive developer community and enterprise market, making ARM-based Windows laptops viable alternatives for Linux-focused workflows.
